# THE [01:17]–[01:21] CAPTURE — a card named by its place, not by its number.
#
# [01:17] the client asks for a new two-bedroom flat in Маџар Маало at about
#         180 000. The feed's flat that answers that is EB 91 — its address says
#         «Гјуро Гјоновиќ Маџар Маало» while the feed files it under «Центар»,
#         so a location-slot search alone ran city-wide and found nothing.
# [01:20] «ОВОЈ КАЈ СЈО ДАЛИ Е ДОСТАПЕН УШТЕ?» points at EB 66 — the card whose
#         own ad says «наспроти СЈО». The old turn answered about EB 91 (the
#         card in play), because the descriptor the resolver saw was the whole
#         rest of the sentence, not the landmark.
# [01:21] «КОЈА МУ Е ЦЕНАТА?» then quoted 178.000 — EB 91's price — for a flat
#         the client had just pointed at as EB 66 (137.000).
#
# The rows below are the feed's own (fetched 2026-10-27), so the replay reads
# exactly the text the client read.
!feed sjo-pair
!state presentation
!eb 91
[01:20] КЛИЕНТ: OVOJ KAJ SJO DALI E DOSTAPEN USHTE ?
# EXPECT no-silence
# EXPECT last-not-mentions 178
[01:21] КЛИЕНТ: KOJA MU E CENATA ?
# EXPECT no-silence
# EXPECT last-mentions 137
# EXPECT last-not-mentions 178
